Provider profile draft

A local, consultation-led approach

The supplied profile says Dr. Patel grew up in Central Florida and graduated from Winter Park High School. It describes an early interest in creative engineering and science, along with volunteering for Habitat for Humanity.

The same source says he earned a Bachelor of Arts and Sciences degree from the University of Florida, majoring in Microbiology and Cell Science, and received his Doctor of Dental Medicine from the University of Florida College of Dentistry.

The care philosophy retained here is to understand each patient’s wants and needs before discussing a plan. These details remain a draft until the practice names an approver and confirms the credentials for publication.
